tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Ubiquiti LBE-M5-23 airMAX LiteBeam M5 – High-Performance 5GHz Wireless Bridge | 100+ Mbps, 30+ km Long-Range PtP & PtMP Link

Upgrade your wireless connectivity with the Ubiquiti LBE-M5-23 airMAX LiteBeam M5, a lightweight yet powerful 5GHz outdoor wireless bridge designed for high-speed, long-distance Point-to-Point (PtP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PtMP) links. Delivering 150+ Mbps throughput with a 23 dBi high-gain directional antenna, this cost-effective solution ensures stable and efficient wireless communication for rural broadband, surveillance networks, ISP backhauls, and enterprise networking.

Key Features:

  • High-Speed Wireless Connectivity: Supports up to 100+ Mbps throughput
  • Long-Range Performance: Provides reliable 30+ km (18+ miles) coverage with a clear line of sight
  • 5GHz High-Gain Antenna: 23 dBi directional antenna enhances signal strength and focus
  • airMAX TDMA Technology: Reduces interference and increases network efficiency
  • Compact & Lightweight Design: Easy to install with a durable UV-resistant enclosure
  • Plug & Play Setup: Quick deployment with intuitive airOS software management

Ideal for:

  • Remote Internet Access
  • CCTV & Surveillance Backhaul
  • Rural & Suburban Broadband Expansion
  • ISP Wireless Networks
  • Enterprise & Industrial Networking

The LiteBeam M5 LBE-M5-23 is a cost-effective, high-performance solution for long-distance wireless networking. Whether you're an ISP, business, or rural user, experience fast, stable, and interference-free connectivity.

Build Features: 



Ubiquiti Default IP & Login Credentials

Default IP Address:

  • 192.168.1.20

Default Login Credentials:

  • Username: ubnt

  • Password: ubnt

Accessing the Ubiquiti Device:

  1. Connect your PC to the Ubiquiti device via Ethernet.

  2. Set your computer's IP to 192.168.1.x (e.g., 192.168.1.10).

  3. Open a web browser and enter http://192.168.1.20.

  4. Log in with ubnt / ubnt as username and password.

Important Notes:

  • For security reasons, change the default credentials after login.

  • If the login fails, reset the device by holding the reset button for 10+ seconds until it reboots.

  • Some newer Ubiquiti devices may require setting up a new password on first login.
